assutaṃ suṇāti, sutaṃ pariyodāpeti, suten'ekaccena visārado hoti, na gāḷhaṃ rog'ātaṅkaṃ phusati, mittavā ca hoti. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ānisaṃsā samavatthacāre'ti.

59505.commentary: (DNa) samavayasaṭṭh'esano'ti ettha avayā'ti anūnā. saṭṭhā'ti vissaṭṭhā. sammā avayā saṭṭhā esanā assā'ti samavayasaṭṭh'esano. sammā vissaṭṭhasabba-esano'ti attho.

examples.text: dasa ariyavāsā. idh'āvuso, bhikkhu pañc'aṅgavippahīno hoti, chaḷaṅgasamannāgato, ek'ārakkho, catur'āpasseno, paṇunnapaccekasacco, samavayasaṭṭh'esano, anāvilasaṅkappo, passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro, suvimuttacitto, suvimuttapañño.

seyyathā'pi, udāyi, puriso daliddo assako anāḷhiyo, tass'assa ekaṃ agārakaṃ oluggaviluggaṃ kāk'ātidāyiṃ naparamarūpaṃ, ekā khaṭopikā oluggaviluggā naparamarūpā, ekissā kumbhiyā dhaññasamavāpakaṃ naparamarūpaṃ, ekā jāyikā naparamarūpā.
yā kho, bhikkhave, imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ saṅgati sannipāto samavāyo, ayaṃ vuccati cakkhusamphasso. cakkhusamphasso'pi anicco vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī.
so evaṃ pajānāti, evañ'hi kira imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ saṅgaho sannipāto samavāyo hoti.

59515.commentary: (MNa) samavisamaṃ carantī'ti kālena samaṃ caranti, kālena visamaṃ.

examples.text: mayam'pi hi manoviññeyyesu dhammesu avītarāgā avītadosā avītamohā, ajjhattaṃ avūpasantacittā, samavisamaṃ carāma kāyena vācāya manasā, tesaṃ no samacariyampi h'etaṃ uttari apassataṃ.
yasmā ca saṅgahā ete, samavekkhanti paṇḍitā, tasmā mahattaṃ papponti, pāsaṃsā ca bhavanti te'ti.

59519.meaning1: having looked carefully; having considered; having inspected; having examined

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, māgadhako gopālako sappaññajātiko, vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye, samavekkhitvā gaṅgāya nadiyā orimaṃ tīraṃ, samavekkhitvā pārimaṃ tīraṃ, titthen'eva gāvo patāresi uttaraṃ tīraṃ suvidehānaṃ.
ete parābhave loke, paṇḍito samavekkhiya, ariyo dassanasampanno, sa lokaṃ bhajate sivan'ti.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu app'ābādho hoti app'ātaṅko, samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato n'ātisītāya n'āccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhānakkhamāya. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo samayo padhānāya.

hirīnisedhā tanuyā, ye caranti sadā satā, antaṃ dukkhassa pappuyya, caranti visame saman'ti.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikasaṅkhalikaṃ samaṃsalohitaṃ nhārusambandhaṃ.
māse māse sahassena, yo yajetha sataṃ samaṃ, ekañ'ca bhāvit'attānaṃ, muhuttam'api pūjaye, sā'y'eva pūjanā seyyo, yañ'ce vassasataṃ hutaṃ.
pañcavedā sataṃ samaṃ, tapassī brāhmaṇā caraṃ, cittañ'ca nesaṃ na sammā vimuttaṃ, hīn'attharūpā na pāraṅ'gamā te.

59538.meaning1: comes into contact; meets together (with); encounters
59538.commentary: (MNa) saṅkunā saṅku hadaye samāgaccheyyā'ti ayasūlena saddhiṃ ayasūlaṃ hadayamajjhe samāgaccheyya. tasmiṃ kira niraye upapannānaṃ tigāvuto attabhāvo hoti, therassā'pi tādiso ahosi. ath'assa hi nirayapālā tālakkhandhapamāṇāni ayasūlāni ādittāni sampajjalitāni sajotibhūtāni sayam'eva gahetvā punappunaṃ nivattamānā, iminā te ṭhānena cintetvā pāpaṃ katan'ti pūvadoṇiyaṃ pūvaṃ koṭṭento viya hadayamajjhaṃ koṭṭetvā, paṇṇāsa janā pād'ābhimukhā paṇṇāsa janā sīs'ābhimukhā koṭṭetvā gacchanti, evaṃ gacchantā pañcahi vassasatehi ubho ante patvā puna nivattamānā pañcahi vassasatehi hadayamajjhaṃ āgacchanti. taṃ sandhāya evaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: app'eva nāma mayaṃ kadāci karahaci tena bhotā gotamena samāgaccheyyāma? app'eva nāma siyā koci'd'eva kathāsallāpo'ti!

no ca sandassako hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno hoti, no parahitāya.

te tena bhotā gotamena dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkamanti avalokayamānā'y'eva avijahitattā.

so taṃ parisaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkamati. so n'ātisīghaṃ gacchati, n'ātisaṇikaṃ gacchati, na ca muccitu'kāmo gacchati.

59581.meaningLit: having caused to place together here

59582.meaning1: composed the mind; stabilized the mind

examples.text: tatra bhikkhavo samādahaṃsu, cittam'attano ujukaṃ akaṃsu, sārathī'va nettāni gahetvā, indriyāni rakkhanti paṇḍitā'ti.

59585.meaning1: having composed the mind; having stabilized the mind

examples.text: saddho so, bhante, ariyasāvako evaṃ padahitvā padahitvā evaṃ saritvā saritvā evaṃ samādahitvā samādahitvā evaṃ pajānitvā pajānitvā evaṃ abhisaddahati.

59588.meaning1: to undertake; to take upon oneself; to observe

examples.text: alajjitāye lajjanti, lajjitāye na lajjare, micchādiṭṭhisamādānā, sattā gacchanti duggatiṃ.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato atīt'ānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ kammasamādānānaṃ ṭhānaso hetuso vipākaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.

59591.meaning1: because of undertaking; due to the taking up (of)

examples.text: so imesaṃ sattannaṃ vatapadānaṃ samādānahetu lābh'aggappatto c'eva yas'aggappatto ca vajjigāme.

59592.commentary: (MNa) manussakantesu sīlesu samādapanāyā'ti ettha yadā nāgo itthipurisehi kumārakumārikāhi soṇḍ'ādīsu gahetvā upakeḷayamāno vikāraṃ na karoti sukhāyati, tadānena manussakantāni sīlāni samādinnāni nāma honti.

examples.text: ehi tvaṃ, samma hatthidamaka, āraññakaṃ nāgaṃ damayāhi āraññakānañ'c'eva sīlānaṃ abhinimmadanāya āraññakānañ'c'eva sarasaṅkappānaṃ abhinimmadanāya āraññakānañ'c'eva darathakilamathapariḷāhānaṃ abhinimmadanāya gām'ante abhiramāpanāya manussakantesu sīlesu samādāpanāyā'ti.

yo kho, cunda, evarūpaṃ sāvakaṃ evaṃ vadeyya, etāyasmā tathā paṭipajjatu, yathā te satthārā dhammo desito paññattoti. yo ca samādapeti, yañ'ca samādapeti, yo ca samādāpito tathattāya paṭipajjati. sabbe te bahuṃ apuññaṃ pasavanti.

59594.meaning1: should be encouraged (to); should be instigated (in)
59594.meaningLit: to cause to be taken together

examples.text: ye, ānanda, anukampeyyātha ye ca sotabbaṃ maññeyyuṃ mittā vā amaccā vā ñātī vā sālohitā vā te vo, ānanda, tīsu ṭhānesu samādāpetabbā nivesetabbā patiṭṭhāpetabbā. katamesu tīsu?

59595.commentary: (MNa) bhavaṃ tesaṃ gotamo samādapetā'ti te kulaputte bhavaṃ gotamo adhisīl'ādīni gāhetā sikkhāpetā.

examples.text: ye'me, bho gotama, kulaputtā bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ uddissa saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā, bhavaṃ tesaṃ gotamo pubbaṅ'gamo, bhavaṃ tesaṃ gotamo bahukāro, bhavaṃ tesaṃ gotamo samādāpetā, bhoto ca pana gotamassa sā janatā diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjatī'ti.

59596.meaning1: arouses; incites; instigates; encourages (someone to do)

examples.text: yo kho, cunda, evarūpaṃ sāvakaṃ evaṃ vadeyya, etāyasmā tathā paṭipajjatu, yathā te satthārā dhammo desito paññattoti. yo ca samādapeti, yañ'ca samādāpeti, yo ca samādapito tathattāya paṭipajjati. sabbe te bahuṃ apuññaṃ pasavanti.

seyyathā'pi nāma pakkhī sakuṇo yena yen'eva ḍeti sapattabhāro'va ḍeti, evam'eva kho ahaṃ, āvuso, santuṭṭho ahosiṃ kāyaparihārikena cīvarena, kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena. so yena yen'eva pakkamiṃ samādāy'eva pakkamiṃ.
yehi tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bālo veditabbo te tayo dhamme abhinivajjetvā, yehi tīhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito veditabbo te tayo dhamme samādāya vattissāmā'ti
sayaṃ samādāya vatāni jantu, ucc'āvacaṃ gacchati saññasatto, vidvā ca vedehi samecca dhammaṃ, na ucc'āvacaṃ gacchati bhūripañño.
